title: Half-term recitation: Ya-Sin 1 to 48 against the rubric: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 28 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Half-term recitation rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 28. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ (٤٥) وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ (٤٦) وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ (٤٧) وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ (٤٨)

keywords.def: the criteria the teacher marks against

questions.q: Half-term check: today's group recites to the teacher (passages chosen at random). Everyone else completes the written task on the pupil PDF.
questions.a: Rubric and target recorded for each pupil.

questions.q: Extend: write your target for Summer 1.
questions.a: For example: 'Keep 'arid at four counts in every ayah end.'

questions.q: «يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ» (36:47): the laam of Allah is ...
questions.a: A) heavy. After the dammah on يَشَآءُ the laam is heavy.
work on my one target daily
options: work on my one target daily

questions.q: Think again: Many Muslims recite Ya-Sin regularly. How will you keep the 48 ayat strong over the coming months?
questions.a: A weekly rota, reciting in salah, and listening to a trusted reciter (voice only).
